title: The Elms Experience: Newport opens 20-room multisensory tour; scents and projections evoke Gilded Age
summary_full: The Elms mansion in Newport, Rhode Island, has introduced a multisensory experience designed to captivate guests. This innovative attraction includes interactive installations that combine scents, sounds, and historical narratives. After three years of development with Digital Kitchen, the mansion’s historical essence is preserved while incorporating QR codes to provide deeper insights. The Preservation Society aims to enrich visitor experiences and modernize storytelling in historic homes, ensuring educational significance remains intact.
